title: SM-16.05 - Can external users still participate in surveys
intent: This article answers: SM-16.05 - Can external users still participate in surveys
short_answer: Yes. Users can still participate in surveys after the new restrictions. The change affects creating and administering surveys, not responding to surveys.
important_conditions: Participation remains possible for surveys created by EU institutions and for external-user surveys that remain active during the transition.
